newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PARMA MAKE SURE OF CHAMPIONS' LEAGUE SLOT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARMA MAKE SURE OF CHAMPIONS' LEAGUE SLOT.

text.p: Parma clinched a place in the Champions' League next season after beating relegated Verona 2-1 on the last day of the Italian serie A season on Sunday to finish as league runners-up.
Juventus clinched the title nine days ago.

Argentine striker Hernan Crespo scored the 64th minute winner for Parma after Verona had taken the lead at home through Pierluigi Orlandini in the sixth minute. Italy international Enrico Chiesa levelled the score after 17 minutes.
Internazionale drew 2-2 with Bologna to finish the season third and four points behind Parma.
Udinese made sure of a UEFA Cup place for the first time in their history by beating a 10-man Roma 3-0. They join Inter, Lazio and Sampdoria. Vicenza are in the Cup Winners' Cup.
At the bottom of the league, Piacenza pulled off a remarkable escape act by beating Perugia 2-1 and staving off relegation for at least another match.
Cagliari beat 10-man Milan 1-0 at San Siro to finish level on points with Piacenza and Perugia.
Under complicated rules, Perugia are relegated with Verona and Reggiana while Cagliari and Piacenza must play again at a neutral venue to decide which of the two survives.
Atalanta's Filippo Inzaghi was top serie A scorer for the season with 24 goals.
